{
  "page_markdown": "Automatic High Frequency Piezo Controller　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　SDVC42-SD

## 2.4 Homepage Parameter Description

The controller can display the main output status, keyboard lock status, port status, monitoring parameters, and interface name on the homepage. Within the port status: Highlighting X indicates that the port is valid. <u>X</u> indicates that the port is valid at low level, and X̅ indicates that the port is valid at high level.

### Homepage display examples

**Example 1**

```text
RUN
A C D E F G N J    A0

UserSped           50
P2.01

UserVoltg          20.0
P2.02              V

+       Home       -
```

| Display area / label | Content shown | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Main output status | `RUN` | Main output status |
| Port status | `A C D E F G N J` | Port status |
| Network / device number | `A0` | `A`: Network Status, `0`: Device number |
| Monitoring parameters 1 | `UserSped`, `P2.01`, `50` | Monitoring parameters 1 |
| Monitoring parameters 2 | `UserVoltg`, `P2.02`, `20.0`, `V` | Inverse selection indicates that the parameter value is adjustable and the main output voltage can be changed. |
| +/- Parameter Adjustment | `+` / `-` | Parameter adjustment keys |
| Interface name | `Home` | Interface name |

**Example 2**

```text
RUN
A C D E F G N J    A0

UserSped           [50]
P2.01

UserVoltg          20.0
P2.02              V

+       Home       -
```

| Display area / label | Content shown | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Monitoring parameters 1 | `UserSped`, `P2.01`, `[50]` | The check box indicates that the parameter value can be adjusted, but the output voltage cannot be changed because the acceleration sensor is not connected. |

## 2.5 Signal Control Ports Definition

| Left function group | Left terminal | Left definition | Right definition | Right terminal | Right function group |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---|
| Digital Sync | T1 | Sync+ | Sync+ | T1 | Digital Sync |
| Digital Sync | T2 | GND | GND | T2 | Digital Sync |
| Digital Sync | T3 | Sync- | Sync- | T3 | Digital Sync |
| Remote Speed Ctrl | A1 | RGND | GND | N1 | Count/Speed Preset |
| Remote Speed Ctrl | A2 | Input | Count/Pset A | G | Count/Speed Preset |
| Remote Speed Ctrl | A3 | 5V Output | Reset/Pset B | N | Count/Speed Preset |
| Remote Speed Ctrl | A4 | GND | 24V Output | N4 | Count/Speed Preset |
| Sensor | C1 | GND | A+ | F2 | RS485 |
| Sensor | C2 | Input | GND | F3 | RS485 |
| Sensor | C3 | 24V Output | B- | F4 | RS485 |
| Sensor Ⅱ | E1 | GND | GND | D3 | Ctrl Out |
| Sensor Ⅱ | E2 | Input | Output | D1 | Ctrl Out |
| Sensor Ⅱ | E3 | 24V Output | 24V Output | D2 | Ctrl Out |
